name: Assassinroid
source:
A Chimeric monster developed to assassinate important people. Able to kill even Queen class monsters, she specialized in stealth and quiet attacks. In order to help her hide herself, her body comes equipped with a special unit to drop all her body heat. Though if she stays too long in this mode, she will then need a few seconds to dump all of the excess heat that has built up. In addition, a second set of genitals was created in her tentacles. Their use is unknown.

She has mastered numerous skills to frustrate any soldier used to attacking head on. Merciless rape awaits any man she defeats.

[From In-game Monsterpedia]
